title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: when the promotional new-money APY applies
content:
## Policy clause

The promotional APY is one of the two tier-specific bonuses that supplement base interest on Savings & Money Market Accounts.

1. The promotional APY applies only on a tier that offers one, only while the day is on or before the account's promotional end date, and only when the new money deposited in the promotional funding window reached the tier's minimum new money.
2. The promotional portion of each day's balance is the balance up to the tier's promotional balance cap. Interest on it is credited as its own interest credit, identified as the promotional component.
3. After the promotional end date, the whole balance earns base interest and any relationship bonus.
4. A tier conversion ends the promotional period on the conversion date.
5. New money deposited after the promotional funding window does not count toward the threshold, but it does earn the promotional APY within the cap.

## What counts as new money

New money is the total of deposits posted from the opening date through the opening date plus the tier's promotional funding window in calendar days, inclusive, that arrived by branch deposit, check deposit, mobile deposit, ACH credit or domestic wire. Internal transfers and automatic transfers from Piedmont Crescent Bank accounts are never new money.

## How the promotional period is counted

- The clock starts from the business event "the account was opened", evidenced by the opening date on the account record, together with the promotional end date recorded at opening.
- Count calendar months from the opening date. A day is within the promotional period when it is on or before the opening date plus the tier's promotional period in calendar months, which is the recorded promotional end date.
- The end date itself is within the period (inclusive boundary); the day after it is not.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates; the 3-month period is illustrative, not a tier value)

| Opening date | Day being accrued | Within the period? |
|---|---|---|
| 15 January | 15 April (opening date plus 3 calendar months) | yes, on the end date |
| 15 January | 16 April | no; from this day the whole balance earns base interest and any relationship bonus |

## Condition table for one day

| Tier offers a promotional APY | Day on or before the end date | New money in the window reached the minimum | Promotional APY on the promotional portion |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | applies |
| yes | yes | no | does not apply |
| yes | no | any | does not apply |
| no | any | any | does not apply |

## Points of judgement

**A customer moved money in from their own PCB checking account during the funding window. Does it count as new money?** No; internal and automatic transfers from PCB accounts are never new money.

**A deposit arrives by ACH credit two weeks after the funding window closed. Does it help reach the threshold?** No; but once the threshold was reached in the window, that later deposit earns the promotional APY within the cap.

**The account converts to another tier during the promotional period. What happens to the promotional APY?** The conversion ends the promotional period on the conversion date.
